Skills Required: 
 HTML 5, CSS 3, Java script and Jquery.
 UI Developer job description: 
 5 plus solid years of Web/UI developing
 Candidate must live locally
 User interface (UI applications and professional Web applications experience)
 Work extensively on design, redesign and development of UX, UI, HTML, CSS and JQuery
 Strong knowledge with HTML/HTML5, XHTML, CSS 2/3, JavaScript, JQuery, AJAX and XML
 Extensive experience in Web based multi-tier enterprise applications and client Server applications using Java/J2EE technologies
 Experience on front-end templating frameworks for JavaScript
 Strong experience working with CSS backgrounds CSS layouts, CSS positioning and CSS animations
 Strong experience with Cross Browser development and adaptive UI development
 Experience supporting large web applications on a daily basis
 Strong analytical, and interpersonal skills
 Financial industry experience a big plus
 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 12+ Months Contract  
 
 INTERVIEW: Interview Process-In Person 
 
 Candidate Must be local
